evidence_schema.description: A gate may be passed only with actual, dated evidence applying to the exact store, theme, commit, SKU, provider or DNS zone. A template is not evidence.

fields.type: Non-sensitive evidence category, such as cli_output, admin_record, legal_record, supplier_record, test_result, owner_approval or dns_query.
fields.observed_at: ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, or a date when the source supplies only a date.
fields.summary: Concise factual result without credentials or personal/payment/customer data.
fields.reference: Repository-relative path or redacted controlled-record identifier.
fields.operator_or_source: Non-sensitive operator role or authoritative source.
fields.scope: Exact store, theme ID, commit, SKU, provider, test order or DNS records covered.
fields.limitations: Known limits, expiry, conditions or reasons the evidence does not pass the gate.

evidence.summary: The storefront password was entered only in the authenticated in-app Browser and manual candidate QA ran at 320, 360, 375, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 px. A 320 px overflow defect was fixed, re-pushed and retested. Core home, empty collection, empty cart, contact and 404 routes plus the updated Main menu, search and cart-drawer interactions passed. The signed-out account button opened Shopify's new customer-account dialog.
evidence.operator_or_source: Authenticated Codex in-app Browser and repository screenshots
evidence.limitations: Only one in-app browser engine was used and its exact version was not recorded. The locally prepared named-footer mapping is not yet evidenced as re-pushed/rendered. No customer credentials were entered, so authentication, post-submit errors, logout and order history remain untested. Accessibility, Lighthouse, product, checkout, contact mailbox delivery and commerce testing did not pass.

evidence.summary: The owner reports support@docked.com.au is set up. Shopify uses it as the configured sender, still labels it Unverified, and a verification email was sent. A controlled Contact form submission was accepted at ?contact_posted=true and Shopify displayed its success confirmation. An attempted external Gmail send did not occur because the connected Gmail account reported Mail service not enabled.
evidence.operator_or_source: Project owner, authenticated Shopify Admin and connected Gmail attempt
evidence.scope: Support mailbox and Shopify sender address for cfbexf-h4.myshopify.com
evidence.limitations: Form acceptance is not mailbox-delivery evidence. No successful external send/receipt/reply, Contact mailbox receipt, order/refund notification or delivered-header SPF/DKIM/DMARC result exists.
